title: Resolve same-name eligible sources deterministically to the newest ACCEPTED producer (R1: exact-name precedence, ordering hardening, drift proofs)
required_tests: src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#consume binds the NEWEST accepted same-name source deterministically
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#exact match wins over a NEWER outbox alias (never displaced)
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#invalid timestamp string is NOT lexical — ranks as unknown
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#newer source arriving later → replay re-proof FAILS, never re-pins
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#dispatch honors PINNED v2 even after v3 lands — never rebinds
description: BASE 43de5e4. LATEST_ACCEPTED (live repro: acceptance_verification failed AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE on journal.html v1/v2 across sibling missions) + R1 audit corrections. Winner selection now partitions matches: EXACT logical_name artifacts always outrank compat aliases (outbox/<basename>) — a newer alias can never silently displace the exact artifact the consume named; aliases bind only when all collapse to ONE logical_name, >1 distinct alias names → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE. Ordering is a deterministic total order: parsed created_at epoch (missing/invalid ranks provably-oldest, never lexical) then artifact_id tiebreak — input array order is never authority. Fail-closed preserved: stamp pins artifact_id+sha256; a newer sibling landing between plan and commit shifts the recomputed winner → replayed ledger mismatch → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_SOURCE_BINDING; dispatch re-proves pinned identity against the live eligible set + CAS bytes (F2-C proves v2 stays bound after v3 lands). R1 tests: F1-A..D exact/alias partitions, F3-A..E ordering determinism (equal ts, shuffled input, missing/invalid ts), F2-A..C drift/no-repin proofs at bind, assert and dispatch seams.
